Installation
As some of the attacks are not available for the heroku or docker run of Juice Shop we shall host it locally. (Don't worry, there isn't much to do.)
Install a 64bit Node.js on your Windows or Linux machine.
i)Browse : https://nodejs.org/en/ and download the version recommended
ii) Run the following commands
>> curl -sL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_12.x | sudo -E bash
>> sudo apt-get install -y nodejs
>> apt -get install -y build-essential
Check your node and npm version
(We have node version 12 and installed it on linux. So we shall download juice shop version-12 and os-linux in the next step)
Download juice-shop-<version>_<node-version>_<os>_x64.zip (or .tgz) attached to the latest release on GitHub .
Browse : https://github.com/bkimminich/juice -shop/releases/tag/v10.3.0 and look for juice shop version 12 & linux release.

Go to the downloaded location -> Extract here .
Open terminal, navigate to the extracted folder and execute :
>> npm start

Now we can log into their accounts. Logout of admin account and navigate the login page.
Add the string ' --after the email ID bender@juice-sh.op and any random characters as password.

Tip: We can log into bender's account by entering ' or 1=1 and email like('%bender%');-- as email and any random string as password.
Similar would be the case for other users or even admin !

Broken Authentication
We know the email of the admin. Let's try to bruteforce the password.

Let's try to reset the Bender's password. Navigate to the Forgot Password page and enter bender's email ID that we extracted in the previous practical. The security question is 'Company you first work for as an adult'.
bend

Upon gathering some background on who Bender is. Upon searching we know bender from Futurama.
Search for details on his first job in
wikipedia(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bender_(Futurama))
Copyright © Rupesh Mittal. All Rights Reserved. Reproduction is Strictly Prohibited.
He used to bend steel girders for suicide booths. Let;s find out more about it. (https://futurama.fandom.com/wiki/Suicide_Booth)
The brand mentioned here -Stop'n'Drop appears as a company. Let's try this as the answer to the security question.
Email: bender@juice-sh.op
Security question : Stop’n’Drop
New Password :12345
Repeat : 12345
Copyright © Rupesh Mittal. All Rights Reserved. Reproduction is Strictly Prohibited.
And we have successfully changed bender's password. Similarly we can do the same for other users.
